name: Główny Szlak Świętokrzyski im. Edmunda Massalskiego
description_md:
The Główny Szlak Świętokrzyski im. Edmunda Massalskiego is a waymarked hiking route in PL measuring 92.9 km. It is signposted as GSŚ and belongs to the national waymarked hiking network.

This hard route involves 2766 m of ascent and 2839 m of descent. The difficulty is derived from the distance and ascent. Walkers can expect a walking time of about 31 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.
